questions.q: On a purchase order, which layer holds the quantity, unit price, and need-by/promised date for a specific line?
options: The header
The approval rule
The supplier site record
The schedule
questions.explain: A line's schedule carries the quantity, price, and dates - and a single line can have multiple schedules for split shipments.

questions.q: Why does most of Marcus's purchase order come pre-populated rather than typed from scratch?
options: Because Marcus processed Dana's already-approved requisition line directly into the purchase order, carrying its details forward
Because Oracle Fusion generates random placeholder values
Because all purchase orders start with identical default values
Because Meridian Bearing Supply Co. entered the data remotely
questions.explain: Processing an approved requisition line into a PO carries forward the item, quantity, need-by date, deliver-to location, and distribution automatically.

questions.q: Which of these fields exists only at the purchase order level, not on the original requisition?
options: The item description
The supplier site and payment terms
The requested quantity
The need-by date
questions.explain: Supplier site and payment terms concern the supplier relationship, which is the buyer's responsibility and only appears once a purchase order exists.

questions.q: What does the match approval level set on the purchase order control?
options: Which requester can submit future requisitions
The exchange rate used for foreign suppliers
Whether the eventual invoice must match against the purchase order alone, or against the purchase order and a receipt
Which chart of accounts segment is used
questions.explain: The match approval level determines the matching requirement (such as 2-way or 3-way) that will apply when the invoice arrives - covered in depth in Chapter 5.

questions.q: What does a purchase order status of "Open" mean?
options: The purchase order is still in draft and has not been submitted
The purchase order has been approved and is now available for receiving and invoicing
The purchase order has been paid in full
The purchase order has been cancelled
questions.explain: Open status indicates the PO is approved and ready for receiving and invoicing activity - only then is it something the supplier can act on.
